user.title: Connect Listenbrücke
user.description: Open Connections → Home Assistant in your Listenbrücke app and create a dedicated app token. Enter the app URL and this token here.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Listenbrücke
reauth_confirm.description: Create a new Home Assistant token in the same Listenbrücke app and enter it here.

reconfigure.title: Update connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the URL and dedicated token of the same Listenbrücke instance.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Listenbrücke app. Check the app URL and whether the app is running.
error.invalid_auth: The dedicated app token is invalid. Create a new Home Assistant token in Listenbrücke.
error.wrong_instance: This URL belongs to a different Listenbrücke instance. Use the originally paired app.

abort.already_configured: This Listenbrücke instance is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The Listenbrücke connection has been renewed.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Listenbrücke connection has been updated.
